title: On the River|Short walk to Broadway & Bridgestone
description:
Experience Nashville from the water’s edge. Our stylish riverfront condo offers the perfect balance; you’re close enough to walk to the neon lights of Broadway and Nissan Stadium, but tucked away in a serene spot with direct river views and a private picture-ready balcony.

The space
HIGHLIGHTS:
⬥ Rare 2-Car Parking: Includes two complimentary spots in a secure, gated garage; save $100+/night in downtown parking fees.
⬥ The Queen Bunk Advantage: A unique setup featuring Queen-over-Queen bunk beds + a Queen trundle (No tiny twins here!).
⬥ True River Views: Relax on your private balcony with a direct view of the Cumberland River.
⬥ Photo-Ready: Features a custom green ivy wall; perfect for your group’s Nashville photo backdrop.
⬥ Walkable Access: A scenic 15-minute walk to Broadway or a 10-minute stroll into Germantown’s elite food scene.
⬥ The Ultimate Coffee Bar: Fully stocked with a Keurig, French Press, Drip machine, and a fresh bean grinder.
⬥ Chef’s Kitchen: Modern stainless appliances and all the essentials for a pre-concert feast.
⬥ Work-from-Woods: High-speed Wi-Fi and Smart TVs in every room for entertainment and productivity.

THE SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 8):
⬥ Bedroom 1: Luxurious King Suite with a private ensuite bathroom.
⬥ Bedroom 2: The Group Suite featuring Queen-over-Queen Bunk Beds + a Queen Trundle bed.
⬥ Living Area: Bright, open-concept lounge with plenty of seating for the whole crew.

THE NEIGHBORHOOD:
⬥ Nissan Stadium: 12-Min Walk (Titans games & concerts)
⬥ Broadway Honky-Tonks: 15-Min Walk
⬥ Germantown Bars/Dining: 8-Min Walk
⬥ BNA Airport: 12-Min Drive

PROFESSIONAL HOSTING:
Managed by a dedicated team of Property Curators. We use organic cleaning supplies and provide 24/7 guest support.

Guest access
- We utilize a digital lock with your own unique code that is emailed to you prior to check-in.
- The entire space is yours. Please make yourself at home.

Other things to note
⬥ We use green & organic cleaning supplies
⬥ There is additional first-come first-serve parking in front of the building. 
⬥ The property is located near a train bridge, and trains may pass at various times during the day or night.  It’s perfect for those who want to be in the middle of the action, but light sleepers may prefer to use the provided earplugs.
